Wade Meckler’s breaking-ball edge and Donovan Walton’s fastball edge rely on small pitch-group samples. Save the rested leverage group—Sam Bachman, Ryan Zeferjahn, and Kirby Yates—for a close late lead. Mitch Farris is limited and reserved for necessity.
reminders: Ureña is the only ready starter option; avoid nibbling with runners aboard.
Use Adell for late right-field defense if the lead-protection tradeoff warrants it.
Keep Farris back unless needed; unavailable players remain out.
